name: Roland JUNO-D
description: Roland JUNO-D (2004) synthesizer: the temporary performance (common, effects, and every part's Part block), the temporary arpeggio, and the Patch-mode patch and rhythm set, from the temporary (edit-buffer) area of the MIDI Implementation.

sources.title: JUNO-D MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, April 1, 2004)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from JUNO-D_MI.pdf (sha256 9023216b42bfb5f2e0fff5cfdca222335fdfedc609bfdce068c2eb4346fac5d9). Model ID 00 64, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Patch mode (18 00 00 00) is the patch or rhythm set played from the keyboard in Patch mode: its patch at 18 00 00 00 and its rhythm set at 18 01 00 00, the key blocks from 18 01 10 00 (key 21) to 18 01 67 00 (key 108), all 88 laid out.

Not modelled: the sixteen Performance Mode parts' own patches and rhythm sets, at 11 00 00 00, 11 02 00 00, … 11 1E 00 00 (part n at 11 00 00 00 + (n-1) × 00 02 00 00, a patch at +00 00 00 and a rhythm set at +01 00 00). Each is the Patch-mode blocks again.

Not modelled: the Temporary Chord (1C 00 00 00). Its offset table (p10) prints "Chord Pattern" at 00 00 00, 00 01 00, ":" and 00 0B 00 with no number, so the twelve entries (eight Chord Pattern Assign notes each, 00 00 00 08) share one name; the generator addresses a block by a unique entry name and refuses an ambiguous one, and the parser does not fill an unnumbered ":" run.

System (p9-10): the top table names "System" at 01 00 00 00 and the manual prints a "System Common" table, Total Size 00 00 00 24, with no "System" offset table between them. System Common is laid at 01 00 00 00, System + 00 00 00.

Presets list the Patches and Rhythm Sets (Bank Select MSB 87 and 86, p1), recalled on the profile's channel, which is the Patch Receive Channel in Patch mode. Performances (MSB 85: User 000, 8; Preset 064, 32) are selected on the Performance Control Channel instead and are not listed; nor are the GM banks (MSB 120/121).

The p24 example's checksum arithmetic prints "10H + 00H + 04H + 00H + 02H = 16 + 0 + 4 + 0 + 6 = 26": the data byte is printed 02H but added as 6, and the message it gives, F0 41 10 00 64 12 10 00 04 00 06 66 F7, carries 06 (SHORT DELAY). The message is the one checked.

coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the MFX type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list. Chorus and reverb have named parameters.
